t: Frogtape Multi-Surface Painters Masking Tape delivers clean, razor-sharp paint lines for professional decorating and refurbishment jobs. Designed with PaintBlock Technology, it forms a micro-barrier that stops paint bleed on cured painted surfaces, wood trim, glass, and metal. The medium adhesion and solvent-free formula ensure strong, quick bonding with clean removal for up to 21 days indoors or 7 days outdoors under UV exposure. Ideal for precise interior or exterior finishing work, performing reliably in temperatures between 20°C and 30°C. Always test first, especially with tricky surfaces or solvent-based paints. For best results, peel off while paint is still wet for super sharp paint lines.
b: For Use on Cured Painted Surfaces, Wood Trim, Glass & Metal
